summary_brief: 今日开源社区在 AI Agent 领域呈现密集的技术演进，多个项目（OpenHands、Agno、Deepagents 等）同时推进外部/原生 Agent 会话的跨副本持久化与恢复能力，使 Agent 基础设施趋近生产级。安全加固成为显著主题——从日志脱敏、命令级 shell 权限到供应链固定版本与代理头校验，多个项目集体强化 AI 代理的安全边界。同时提示词缓存、上下文压缩等长对话成本优化与 Prompt caching 稳定性成为跨项目的性能关注焦点。

engineering_signals.title: 外部 Agent 会话跨副本持久化与恢复成为基础设施标配
engineering_signals.why_it_matters: OpenHands、Agno 等多个平台将 ClaudeAgent/CodexAgent 会话持久化，使外部 Agent 能在任意副本上恢复并支持后台运行、取消、重试与结构化输出，标志多代理平台将外部 Agent 能力提升到与原生一致的水平，是 Agent 基础设施走向生产级的关键一步。

engineering_signals.title: Agent 权限最小化浪潮：从命令级 shell 到会话级访问控制
engineering_signals.why_it_matters: 多个项目（Deepagents、Codex、OpenClaw）同步将权限粒度从宽泛的『始终允许』收窄到精确命令与参数级别，并新增 LocalBoard 连接级读写隔离、blocked-shell 收敛，体现了 Agent 权限模型从粗放授权向精细最小化的集体进化，是 AI 代理安全护栏的核心趋势。

engineering_signals.title: 供应链安全加固：固定版本、路径授权与依赖退役
engineering_signals.why_it_matters: 项目集体防范供应链攻击面：CLI 固定精确版本、升级 Hono 修复路径授权绕过、退役不兼容后端，多个项目同时堵住无审查代码执行与依赖被攻陷的风险，反映 AI 工具链对供应链安全的高度重视。

engineering_signals.title: 提示词缓存与上下文成本优化成为多项目共同发力点
engineering_signals.why_it_matters: OpenCode 可配置 Anthropic 缓存断点格式、OpenClaw 与 Deepagents 稳定跨运行提示前缀并压缩后保留上下文、LangGraph 保障缓存前缀字节一致，多个项目围绕提示缓存命中率与长会话 token 成本展开系统性优化，反映 Agent 厂商将推理成本控制作为核心竞争维度。

engineering_signals.title: 模型会话能力标准化声明（mid-conversation）落地
engineering_signals.why_it_matters: langchain-core 为 ModelProfile 新增 mid_conversation 字段，anthropic/openai 包同步声明，提供模型会话中途系统消息与工具约束的标准描述方式，是长会话 Agent 架构模型匹配的通用抽象，正被多个框架采用。

engineering_signals.title: 第三方工具生态接入与上下文瘦身并行推进
engineering_signals.why_it_matters: Cline 通过元搜索工具按需加载 Composio 工具 schema 削减 token，同时支持宿主侧认证，并在 MCP 层暴露工具注解以制定审批策略——第三方工具生态在接入便利性与上下文开销之间寻求平衡。

engineering_signals.title: Provider 原生压缩默认启用与上下文溢出韧性提升
engineering_signals.why_it_matters: LangChain 对 OpenAI/Anthropic API-key 路由默认启用 provider-native compaction，OpenClaw 在压缩恢复耗尽后支持模型降级，多个项目共同完善长会话 Agent 的上下文溢出管理与运行韧性。

engineering_signals.title: AI Agent 可观测性生态完善：W3C 追踪与 span 可靠性
engineering_signals.why_it_matters: Goose 实现 W3C trace context 从 ACP 到 MCP 的跨协议传播，Phoenix 强化 span 摄取可靠性并支持空 DataFrame，Codex 暴露外部 Agent SDK 标记，Agent 可观测性从单点走向跨协议、跨平台的分布式追踪。

engineering_signals.title: 新一代模型快速接入潮：GPT-6.1、Haiku 5.5、Gemini 齐头并进
engineering_signals.why_it_matters: LlamaIndex 同步接入 GPT-6.1 Sol 与 Claude Haiku 5.5，promptfoo 支持最新 Gemini 媒体模型，多框架同一周期内跟进前沿多模态模型，反映低成本高性能模型正成为多厂商推理默认选项。

engineering_signals.title: 异步子 Agent 协作新模式：fork 模式与共享历史
engineering_signals.why_it_matters: Deepagents 与 AgentScope 为异步子 Agent 引入 fork 模式，共享对话历史进行后台工作而无需重复陈述上下文，代表 Agent 架构中更高效的子代理协作新模式，同时修复并行调用时父级 rubric 丢失问题。

engineering_signals.title: 推理模型长思考挑战流式超时与工具链适配
engineering_signals.why_it_matters: OpenCode 将推理模型 chunk 超时提升至 15 分钟并绕过 Bun fetch 空闲超时，直接回应 DeepSeek 等推理模型长时间无回显导致的截断问题，反映长思考模型对现有流式与工具链架构的适配需求成为现实工程挑战。

engineering_signals.title: vercel/ai 全链路 citation 能力落地
engineering_signals.why_it_matters: vercel/ai 批量发布 111 个子包，核心引入可选共享 citations 引用表示与 Citation 类型，openai/anthropic provider 规范化检索来源，openai-compatible 新增 file_id 文件引用支持，LLM 输出引用的可溯源能力正在 AI SDK 层标准化。

engineering_signals.title: Agent 日志与记忆的隐私脱敏加固
engineering_signals.why_it_matters: Semantic Kernel 不再在日志中记录函数参数值、OpenClaw 修复凭据跨块边界泄露并提升脱敏性能、Redis 会话历史原子替换防丢失，多个项目共同强化 Agent 运行时的数据隐私与记忆可靠性，是 Agent 走向企业级的关键安全防线。

engineering_signals.title: Agent 产品 UI 与配置体验升级
engineering_signals.why_it_matters: OpenHands 完善自动化设置流程 UI（分屏面板、草稿管理），OpenClaw 迁移到 Solid 框架并自动选择推理，Zed 优化编辑导航，多个 Agent 工具集体降低上手门槛、提升配置体验。

engineering_signals.title: 图执行引擎状态管理与增量历史机制强化
engineering_signals.why_it_matters: LangGraph 1.2.15 对 DeltaChannel 增量历史记录（消息 ID 分配、快照、重放顺序）进行大量修复，与 Redis/SQLite 检查点发布同步推进，反映 Agent 图执行引擎对状态一致性、重放与恢复能力的持续打磨。

engineering_signals.title: 工具调用上下文管理与多服务器抽象优化
engineering_signals.why_it_matters: deer-flow 按 MCP 服务器粒度重构工具发现以明确契约、CrewAI 改用 LiteLLM 目录维护上下文窗口消除模型 ID 漂移、Codex 通过元工具减少 schema 开销，多项目针对多工具/多模型架构下的上下文管理与抽象明确性展开优化。

release_signals.title: 外部Agent会话持久化与恢复
release_signals.why_it_matters: ClaudeAgent和CodexAgent会话可在任意副本恢复，支持后台运行、取消、重试、指标采集和结构化输出，将外部Agent能力提升到与原生Agent一致的水平，是Agent基础设施的重要完善。

release_signals.title: 外部Agent会话持久化与恢复
release_signals.why_it_matters: ClaudeAgent和CodexAgent会话可在任意副本恢复，支持后台运行、取消、重试、指标采集和结构化输出，将外部Agent能力提升到与原生Agent一致的水平，是Agent基础设施的重要完善。

release_signals.title: DeltaChannel增量历史机制
release_signals.why_it_matters: LangGraph 1.2.15对DeltaChannel的增量历史记录进行了大量修复，包括消息ID分配、快照、重放顺序等，显著提升了状态管理的可靠性和一致性，是图执行引擎的核心改进。

release_signals.title: 模型配置文件中会话支持声明
release_signals.why_it_matters: langchain-core、anthropic和openai包同步声明mid-conversation支持，为模型能力描述提供了标准化方式，有助于上层应用更准确地选择模型。

release_signals.title: Provider原生压缩默认启用
release_signals.why_it_matters: OpenAI和Anthropic API-key路由默认启用provider-native compaction，并支持主认证配置冷却时的恢复，大幅提升长对话场景的上下文管理效率和稳定性。

release_signals.title: Prompt缓存稳定性增强
release_signals.why_it_matters: 确保Anthropic对话检查点、用户提示、工具结果在后续轮次、重放、Gateway重启后保持字节一致，使缓存前缀持续命中，显著降低延迟和成本。

release_signals.title: 秘密信息跨块边界脱敏
release_signals.why_it_matters: 修复长工具输出中凭据跨块边界泄露的问题，同时将脱敏性能提升数倍，是Agent安全性的重要加固。

release_signals.title: ACP内置Agent支持扩展
release_signals.why_it_matters: OpenHands新增OpenCode和Pi作为内置ACP Agent，并支持从Agent动态获取模型列表，扩展了Agent互操作性的生态。

release_signals.title: Agent Canvas连接DigitalOcean托管Agent
release_signals.why_it_matters: Agent Canvas桌面端和Web端可连接DigitalOcean Managed Agents，打通了本地开发工具与云托管Agent服务的集成。

release_signals.title: 自动化设置流程UI完善
release_signals.why_it_matters: 新增启动页模式切换、自动化设置分屏面板、Agent辅助表单更新和持久化草稿管理，大幅提升Agent自动化配置的用户体验。

release_signals.title: 服务端技能信任校验
release_signals.why_it_matters: deepagents-code在服务端解析并检查被调用技能的信任状态，为技能执行增加了安全边界。

release_signals.title: 异步子Agent Fork模式支持
release_signals.why_it_matters: deepagents SDK支持异步子Agent的fork模式，并修复并行调用时父级rubric丢失和上下文溢出恢复问题，增强了多Agent协作的可靠性。

release_signals.title: Shell权限精确到命令级
release_signals.why_it_matters: deepagents-acp的shell权限仅应用于被授权的精确命令，收紧了Agent执行环境的安全边界。

release_signals.title: Orbital主题与主题工作室
release_signals.why_it_matters: ruflo-console新增可选的Orbital视觉风格和Theme Studio，支持自定义主题、颜色预设和动画控制，提升终端UI的个性化能力。

release_signals.title: 策略信封计量与Codex后端退役
release_signals.why_it_matters: ruflo 3.56.9要求显式策略信封上限必须计量，同时退役已不兼容的Codex MCP后端，避免启动卡顿，是安全策略和依赖管理的双重更新。

release_signals.title: Span摄取可靠性提升
release_signals.why_it_matters: Arize Phoenix改进span摄取可靠性并支持空DataFrame，提升可观测性数据管道的健壮性。

release_signals.title: vercel/ai 批量发版 111 个子包（6 个值得注意）
release_signals.why_it_matters: vercel/ai 本次共发布 111 个子包，整体以 patchesets 例行的版本同步为主（大量子包仅随 ai 核心依赖升级），但核心包 ai@7.0.138 / @ai-sdk/provider 引入了新增的可选 citations 引用表示能力，openai-compatible 新增 file_id 文件引用支持，属于实质性新功能；同时各 provider 针对未知模型 ID 的 structured output、reasoning、browser search 等做了大量兼容性修复。无 breaking changes，综合影响等级为 3。

release_signals.title: vercel/ai ai@7.0.138
release_signals.why_it_matters: 核心包引入可选共享 citations 引用表示，新增 Citation 类型与 text/text-end 流事件支持，属实质新能力

release_signals.title: vercel/ai @ai-sdk/provider@4.0.27
release_signals.why_it_matters: 底层 provider 增加可选的共享引用表示，作为全链路 citation 能力基础

release_signals.title: vercel/ai @ai-sdk/openai@4.0.92
release_signals.why_it_matters: 暴露完整 web-search/file-search 来源并规范化 citations，JSON 编码自定义工具输入增量等多个 fix

release_signals.title: vercel/ai @ai-sdk/anthropic@4.0.79
release_signals.why_it_matters: 保留 web/document 检索来源并与 citations 分离，导出 AnthropicCitation 等新类型，纠正工具调用行为

release_signals.title: vercel/ai @ai-sdk/openai-compatible@3.0.68
release_signals.why_it_matters: 新增支持通过 file_id 上传文件引用（新能力）

release_signals.title: vercel/ai @ai-sdk/amazon-bedrock@5.0.114
release_signals.why_it_matters: 针对 Claude 结构化输出与 strict tools 行为调整，未来模型 ID 改用 JSON instructions

releases.summary:
# Changelog

## New Features:

- **Durable External Agent Sessions**: `ClaudeAgent` sessions now resume on any replica. The Claude SDK session id is stored on the Agno session (#10903), and with a database that supports transcript storage (`PostgresDb`, `AsyncPostgresDb`, `SqliteDb`, `AsyncSqliteDb`) every transcript line is mirrored into the new `agno_transcripts` table, so a later turn on another machine resumes from the database instead of a local file. A stored session that cannot be resumed falls back to a fresh SDK session seeded with the Agno history. Claude and Codex non-streaming runs now keep tool calls and results in run history. See [cookbook](https://github.com/agno-agi/agno/blob/main/cookbook/frameworks/claude-agent-sdk/transcript_store.py). (#10904)
- **Background Runs & Cancellation for External Agents**: `ClaudeAgent` and `CodexAgent` support `background=True`, durable-queue run ids, resumable indexed SSE and cancellation through `/agents/{id}/runs/{run_id}/cancel`, sharing the background task, slot and event-stream infrastructure of native agents. Claude uses a per-run SDK client and Codex retains turn handles, so the owning process can interrupt either SDK. See [cookbook](https://github.com/agno-agi/agno/blob/main/cookbook/frameworks/claude-agent-sdk/background_cancel.py). (#10905)
- **Step Replay for ClaudeAgent**: `ClaudeAgent.continue_run` / `acontinue_run` take the same `continue_from`, `fork` and `input` arguments as `Agent.continue_run`, with `stream=True` and `background=True`. Each tool result is a checkpoint listed by `GET /agents/{id}/runs/{run_id}/checkpoints`; continuing forks the stored SDK transcript at that message, so the model only remembers what happened up to it, and `continue_from="last_user"` replays the turn. A finished run is never rewritten in place: its continuation is a new sibling run. See [cookbook](https://github.com/agno-agi/agno/blob/main/cookbook/frameworks/claude-agent-sdk/continue_from/01_continue_finished_run.py). (#10917)
- **Retries for External Agents**: `ClaudeAgent` and `CodexAgent` take `retries`, `delay_between_retries` and `exponential_backoff` with the same defaults as `Agent`. A failed attempt is retried with the same run id and resumes the SDK session or Codex thread it started; limits (`max_turns`, `max_budget_usd`, Codex budget and usage limits) and permanent errors (authentication, billing, bad requests, context window, policy) are not retried. Tool calls from failed attempts are kept exactly once, streaming consumers get a `type: "retry"` warning event between attempts, a retried run records `metadata["attempts"]`, and the durable queue fails a job at once when the agent marks its error non-retryable, including across worker restarts. See [cookbook](https://github.com/agno-agi/agno/blob/main/cookbook/frameworks/claude-agent-sdk/claude_retries.py). (#10937)
- **Metrics for External Agents**: Every `ClaudeAgent` and `CodexAgent` run reports tokens, cache usage and cost (Claude) on `RunOutput.metrics`, with one entry per model in `metrics.details["model"]`, plus Agno's wall-clock `duration` and `time_to_first_token`. Completed runs accumulate into the session's `session_metrics`, which AgentOS shows in the sessions list, the session view and `/metrics`. Codex sums every model request in a turn, not only the last one. See [cookbook](https://github.com/agno-agi/agno/blob/main/cookbook/frameworks/claude-agent-sdk/metrics_agentos.py). (#10925)
- **Compaction for External Agents**: Claude Code's `/compact` works through the database-backed session store, so a compacted session resumes from its summary on any replica, and `CodexAgent.compact` / `acompact` compact the Codex thread behind an Agno session. Compaction refuses while a run on the session is in flight. See [cookbook](https://github.com/agno-agi/agno/blob/main/cookbook/frameworks/codex/codex_compaction.py). (#10924)
- **Stored Events for External Agents**: `BaseExternalAgent` takes `store_events` and `events_to_skip` like `Agent`. AgentOS turns it on for external agents, so the run view and `/agents/{id}/runs/{run_id}/resume` replay a finished run from the database once the event stream's retention has expired, in order and honouring `last_event_index`. (#10957, #10958)
- **Structured Output for External Agents**: `output_schema` on `ClaudeAgent` and `CodexAgent` takes a Pydantic model or a JSON Schema dict, on the agent or per run, and the run's content is the parsed model (or dict) with `content_type` set, as for `Agent`. Claude delivers the object through its structured output tool, which is not recorded as a tool call; Codex receives a strict schema. The schema must describe a JSON object; an array or scalar root is refused before the run. The AgentOS per-request `output_schema` form field now applies to external agents. See [cookbook](https://github.com/agno-agi/agno/blob/main/cookbook/frameworks/claude-agent-sdk/structured_output.py). (#10965)
- **Media for External Agents**: Images and files can be attached to `ClaudeAgent` and `CodexAgent` runs, directly and through the AgentOS API and UI. Attachments are staged under `<cwd>/.agno/uploads/<run_id>/`, named in the prompt (Codex also receives images natively), recorded on the run's input, restored for later turns on any replica and removed after the run unless `keep_uploads=True`. Audio and video are rejected with a 400 instead of a server error. See [cookbook](https://github.com/agno-agi/agno/blob/main/cookbook/frameworks/claude-agent-sdk/claude_media.py). (#10926)
- **External Agent Identity on Session APIs**: `GET /sessions`, `GET /sessions/{session_id}` and the session run reads carry the same `metadata.sdk` value as the agents API (`"codex"`, `"claude-agent-sdk"`), overlaid at read time from the `agent_data` external agents already persist, so existing sessions are labelled with no migration and stored metadata is untouched. Native, team and workflow sessions are unchanged. `RunSchema` gains a `metadata` field, which also surfaces run metadata such as retry `attempts` and `warnings`. (#11020)
- **AnakinTools**: New toolkit for Anakin.io's scrape, crawl, map and search APIs as four flag-gated methods, polling asynchronous jobs until they complete so the model receives page content or links rather than a job id. See [cookbook](https://github.com/agno-agi/agno/blob/main/cookbook/91_tools/anakin_tools.py). (#10650)

## Improvements:

- **External Agent APIs**: `ClaudeAgent` and `CodexAgent` take typed native options (tools, permissions, MCP servers, thread and turn options) instead of untyped `_kwargs` dictionaries, which still work with a warning. Adapter constructors are keyword-only, `agent.sdk` names the SDK (API and session metadata emit only `sdk`; the `framework` alias remains on the Python object), and `print_response` / `aprint_response` return the final run and raise on failure. Framework cookbooks were reworked with native SDK comparisons, a sample project and a reproducible reliability kit. (#10926)
- **Model Identity for External Agents**: `ClaudeAgent` and `CodexAgent` runs record `model` and `model_provider` like native agents, so they count on the Models Runs card of the AgentOS metrics page. When no model is set on the agent or in its options, `model` defaults to `claude-sonnet-4-6` for Claude and `gpt-5.6-luna` for Codex, as a native model has a default id; the default is what the SDK is asked to run. A model set in options still wins. Previously an unset model left the choice to the CLI. (#11018)
- **Queued Turns Per Session**: Queued external-agent turns on one session no longer claim attempts together and burn them on `SessionBusyError`. Each built-in queue store (Postgres, Redis, in-memory) elects the next turn for a session before it spends an attempt or a worker slot. (#10974)
- **Harness Cookbooks**: The Claude and Codex cookbooks were refreshed after Phase 1 acceptance testing with typed native options throughout, a corrected reliability runner, and live results recorded in each folder's test log. (#10973)
- **One Turn Per Session**: Claude Code and Codex keep one conversation per session on their side, so a second turn started while one is in flight is now refused with `SessionBusyError` (HTTP 409, `error_type: session_busy`) instead of being accepted and failing later. Cancelling a run left pending or running by a crash frees its session. (#10958)
- **Subagent Tool Lineage**: Tool calls made by Claude subagents carry `parent_tool_call_id` on `ToolExecution` and on tool events, so tracing shows nested tool spans under the delegating tool. See [cookbook](https://github.com/agno-agi/agno/blob/main/cookbook/frameworks/claude-agent-sdk/continue_from/07_subagent_checkpoints.py). (#10959)
- **Development Setup**: `scripts/dev_setup.sh` and `scripts/demo_setup.sh` install the same dependencies, so cookbooks run from either environment. (#10920)

## Bug Fixes:

- **Session Busy Keep-Alive**: The 409 for a busy external-agent session is answered by a dedicated `SessionBusyError` handler instead of the catch-all, so the keep-alive connection stays open and the conflict is logged as a warning rather than a traceback. The response body is unchanged and no other exception takes the new path. See [cookbook](https://github.com/agno-agi/agno/blob/main/cookbook/frameworks/claude-agent-sdk/session_busy_agentos.py). (#11017)
- **Attachment Staging**: Files attached to external-agent runs are staged and restored only under the active workspace, with the harness told when historical paths moved. A failed staging rolls back every file it created, including partial writes and with `keep_uploads=True`, while preexisting files are preserved. Traversal run ids and symlinked upload paths are rejected. (#10971)
- **Run Input Validation**: Malformed JSON `images`, `audio`, `videos` and `input_files` on run requests are rejected with HTTP 422 before dispatch instead of vanishing or failing mid-run, and a malformed or scalar-root `output_schema` is rejected instead of being silently dropped. (#11005)
- **CodexAgent**: Failed tool calls (a non-zero exit, a declined command, an MCP tool error) are stored with `tool_call_error=True` instead of `null`, on streamed and non-streamed runs. (#10958)
- **CodexAgent**: When a thread cannot be resumed, the history replayed into the fresh thread now includes earlier tool calls and their results, truncated to 2000 characters each, instead of only user and assistant text. (#10909)
- **External Agent Resume**: `/resume` on a run submitted with `stream=false` reports the run's real status and says to poll the run endpoint, instead of claiming the run completed while it was still running. (#10958)
- **Tests**: The partial-tool collision test no longer depends on FastMCP's tool naming. (#10914)

## What's Changed
* fix: persist ClaudeAgent SDK session id across restarts by @ysolanky in https://github.com/agno-agi/agno/pull/10903
* fix: make partial-tool collision test independent of FastMCP's naming by @sannya-singal in https://github.com/agno-agi/agno/pull/10914
* fix: include tool calls in Codex fallback history prompt by @ysolanky in https://github.com/agno-agi/agno/pull/10909
* feat: persist external agent transcripts and tool results by @ashpreetbedi in https://github.com/agno-agi/agno/pull/10904
* [feat] Add AnakinTools: scrape, crawl, map and search via Anakin.io by @aryan-anakin in https://github.com/agno-agi/agno/pull/10650
* feat: add background lifecycle and cancellation to external agents by @ashpreetbedi in https://github.com/agno-agi/agno/pull/10905
* chore: align dev and demo setup environments by @ashpreetbedi in https://github.com/agno-agi/agno/pull/10920
* feat: continue ClaudeAgent runs from a step by @ysolanky in https://github.com/agno-agi/agno/pull/10917
* feat: capture ext agent harness metrics by @kausmeows in https://github.com/agno-agi/agno/pull/10925
* fix: keep failed attempts' tools and announce retries to streaming consumers by @kausmeows in https://github.com/agno-agi/agno/pull/10937
* feat: compaction cookbooks for Claude and Codex, CodexAgent.compact by @kausmeows in https://github.com/agno-agi/agno/pull/10924
* feat: store run events for external agents by @kausmeows in https://github.com/agno-agi/agno/pull/10957
* feat: preserve Claude subagent tool lineage for tracing by @kausmeows in https://github.com/agno-agi/agno/pull/10959
* feat: output_schema for external agents (Claude, Codex) by @ysolanky in https://github.com/agno-agi/agno/pull/10965
* fix: harness soak follow-ups: tool errors, resume status, one turn per session by @kausmeows in https://github.com/agno-agi/agno/pull/10958
* feat: improve external agent APIs and framework cookbooks by @ashpreetbedi in https://github.com/agno-agi/agno/pull/10926

* fix: confine harness attachment staging and roll back failures by @ashpreetbedi in https://github.com/agno-agi/agno/pull/10971
* fix: reject malformed run media and output schema inputs by @ashpreetbedi in https://github.com/agno-agi/agno/pull/11005
* cookbook: validate Phase 1 harness examples and reliability contracts by @ashpreetbedi in https://github.com/agno-agi/agno/pull/10973

releases.summary:
Patch release: `@claude-flow/cli`, `claude-flow`, `ruflo` 3.56.9 (latest, alpha, v3alpha). The bundled leaves `@claude-flow/security` 3.0.5 and `@claude-flow/codex` 3.0.5 were published standalone first, and the CLI pins them, `@claude-flow/shared` 3.0.5 and `@claude-flow/cli-core` 3.7.2 exactly. Signed helpers changed (`hook-handler.cjs`, re-signed in #4096).

### Fixed
- **Policy envelope** (`security` 3.0.5): explicit envelope ceilings require metering, and unmetered worker ceilings stay opt-in (#3503, @rudycelekli).
- **Codex MCP backend** (`codex` 3.0.5 and the ruflo wrapper bridge): the opt-in `codex` backend no longer launches `@openai/codex mcp-server`, which current Codex CLI dropped, and is retired without a startup stall (#3522, @rudycelekli; reported in #3509 by @pacphi).
- **CLI parser, retry, rate-limit, monitoring and config fixes**: a reviewed batch (#4107, covering #4000-#4017, @rudycelekli and others).
- `analyze diff` renders the `analyze_diff` result shape (#4102, fixes #4101, @z4forzubair).
- `shared` 3.0.5 and `cli-core` 3.7.2: narrow-column truncation, rate-window retry times, structured network error codes (#4014, #4015, #4018, @rudycelekli).
- **ruflo-mods guards** (#4096, @proffesor-for-testing): the root-delete guard no longer misses brace, nesting and fork-bomb forms, the screen `.env` check is fixed, and `init`-generated hooks carry the changes.
- **Console** (marketplace plugin; its `tui.mjs` is bundled into the CLI): worktree removal runs no fsmonitor or hooks and keeps untracked files (#4092), `console_state` reports an expired confirm card (#4067), pictures draw as SVG on Claude Code Desktop (#4112), all by @proffesor-for-testing; the Skills page pins its skills CLI (#4113, @martinvlad).
- `ruflo-cost-tracker` logs Stop-hook telemetry write failures instead of discarding them (#3227, @nicholas-ruest; marketplace plugin).
- CI runs every v3 root-suite test file and no longer accepts a crashed run as a pass (#4099, @proffesor-for-testing); not part of the package.

### Thanks
@rudycelekli, @proffesor-for-testing, @z4forzubair, @nicholas-ruest, @martinvlad, @ronmikailov (whose reports shaped the 3.56.7 and 3.56.8 trains) and @pacphi.

key_changes: 修复策略信封（Policy envelope）功能：显式封顶上限需要计量（metering），未计量工作节点的封顶保持可选加入
修复 Codex MCP 后端：不再启动已被移除的 @openai/codex mcp-server，避免启动停顿
修复 ruflo-mods 安全防护：覆盖花括号、嵌套、fork-bomb 等多种根目录删除形式，修复屏幕 .env 检查
修复 CLI 解析器、重试、限流、监控及配置相关的批量问题（#4000-#4017）
修复 Console 插件：工作树移除不再触发 fsmonitor/hooks，保留未跟踪文件；过期确认卡片状态报告；SVG 图片渲染支持
ai_summary.summary_cn: 这是 ruvnet/ruflo 的补丁版本，主要修复了策略信封的安全性、Codex MCP 后端的启动问题以及 CLI 解析/重试/限流/监控等多项缺陷。同时强化了 ruflo-mods 防根目录删除的守卫逻辑，并修复了 Console 插件在多个场景下的功能异常。本次发布还更新了签名辅助工具，并改进了 CI 对崩溃运行的处理。

Patch release: `@claude-flow/cli`, `claude-flow`, `ruflo` 3.56.8 (latest, alpha, v3alpha). The CLI now pins `@claude-flow/shared` 3.0.4 (3.56.7 still pinned 3.0.3). No other published package changed since 3.56.7; signed helpers did not change.

### Fixed
- **`@claude-flow/shared` 3.0.4**: the RVF event log repairs an incomplete or damaged tail before appending (#4031, @rudycelekli). A clean install can import `.`, `./core` and `./mcp` because zod and express are now declared, and the tarball no longer ships compiled tests (#4089, #4091, @proffesor-for-testing). The fresh-consumer finding behind this came from @martinvlad, and `scripts/smoke-shared-fresh-consumer.mjs` now covers it.
- **`hooks coverage-gaps`**: files with no executable lines are no longer reported as 0%, overall coverage is line-weighted, the command reads `coverage-final.json`, and report size is capped (#4082-#4084 reported by @ronmikailov; #4097). Plugin workflow contracts for ruflo-testgen and ruflo-sparc were corrected in the same change (#4085-#4088; marketplace plugins, not npm).
- **`ruflo tui`**: the page bar marks the AI page (6 AI) when started with `--view ai`, and the help text says pages 1-6 (#4105, #4106). The policy-trust path is never resolved relative to the working directory (#4106).

## ruflo-console 0.43.0: optional Orbital look and Theme Studio

Classic BBS stays the default. Orbital is opt-in; nothing changes until you pick it.

### Changelog
- **feat:** an optional **Orbital** look: black telemetry panels, square borders, a rotating globe, a scan sweep and a shaded RUFLO header that stays visible after boot (Main Menu, Theme Studio, Swarm), animated real boot checks, a perspective swarm preview.
- **feat:** **Theme Studio** (Main Menu → Tools, Settings, or `/ruflo themes`): pick Classic BBS, Terminal plain or Orbital; six bundled color presets; up to twelve named custom themes saved through host storage; a color picker with a 3:1 minimum contrast; motion layers and speed; `fps` 0 freezes the frame.
- **feat:** a bundled `generate-console-theme` skill (`allowed-tools: Read`) returns data-only palette/motion JSON for Claude or Codex; import goes through a strict, 4096-character-bounded schema.
- **fix:** Theme Studio has a boot-log line and a help guide and is reached by name; the wide Orbital header says RUFLO, not RUVNET.
- **chore:** the globe reads a one-degree land mask built once (about a third less time per frame); `scripts/bench-theme.mjs`; no Python in the repo (the SVG demo exporter is Node).

### Validation
- Console tests: 0 failing (main and this release both skip 29 files that need `claude-code/testing`); 3193 pass (+77). Console smoke 20/20; manifest, mcp-prefix, skill-frontmatter, hook audits and `claude plugin validate` pass; CI 114 checks green.
- Checked in the real Claude Code 2.1.289 (isolated config, directory marketplace, tmux, frames viewed): `/ruflo`, Orbital and Classic, Tools → Theme Studio, `/ruflo themes`, colour edit, contrast guard, save and reload across a full restart, "Use configured look", malformed/hostile JSON rejected with the theme unchanged, animation running (12/12 distinct frames) and stopped at `fps` 0, resizes 300→150 columns, clean model-facing `console_state` (no escapes, no theme JSON).
- 45 adversarial specs on import, stores and model-facing text found no defect. Classic BBS per-tick cost is unchanged from before.

### Not verified
Windows and macOS terminals, other emulators (tmux 256-colour only), the desktop and VS Code surfaces, a real AI-generated theme round trip (Generate with Claude/Codex was not run), and some stray `│` cells right of the pane after a shrink-resize in tmux (looks like host diff-render residue). The side-by-side editor layout needs a pane of 100+ columns (the host's default share is narrower; `RUFLO_CONSOLE_COLUMNS` widens it).

### Install
Marketplace plugin, not npm: `claude plugin marketplace update ruflo` then `claude plugin update ruflo-console@ruflo`, and restart Claude Code.

PR [#4079](https://github.com/ruvnet/ruflo/pull/4079). Orbital and Theme Studio by @ruvnet (with Codex); review, fixes, validation and optimization by RuFlo.

key_changes: 新增可选的 Orbital 视觉风格：黑色遥测面板、方形边框、旋转地球仪、扫描动效及持久显示的 RUFLO 头部导航

- **Secret redaction:** credentials that cross a chunk boundary in long tool output are now masked, and redaction of large text no longer stalls or overflows the stack while running several times faster. (#161480, #166701, #167943) Thanks @eleqtrizit.
- **Prompt-cache stability:** Anthropic conversation checkpoints, enriched user prompts, tool results, and inter-session provenance stay byte-identical across follow-ups, replays, Gateway restarts, and subagent completions, so cached prefixes keep hitting. (#168042, #167938, #168392, #167898, #169130, #169238) Thanks @RomneyDa.
- **Gateway responsiveness:** Control UI reconnects, model changes with large plugins, dashboard title work, and catalog loading no longer freeze the Gateway or hang new sessions. (#167374, #161267, #162689, #166089, #166376) Thanks @jalehman, @obviyus, @ericcaiwx-star, @cursoragent, @dimonnld, and @dprev.

### Changes

- Defaulted OpenAI and Anthropic API-key routes to provider-native compaction. (#168164) Thanks @obviyus.
- Reported finalized update successes and suppressed channels as warnings instead of failures. (#169037)
- Stopped live npm dist-tag drift from failing already-validated release candidates. (#168836) Thanks @RomneyDa.

### Fixes

- Fixed credential leaks across redaction chunk boundaries and redaction stalls on large tool output. (#161480) Thanks @eleqtrizit.
- Fixed replies lost while an agent finishes starting, streamed Telegram replies vanishing when the replacement message never lands, and Telegram treating local owner rejection as ambiguous delivery. (#168826, #164649, #167470) Thanks @xiaozishan, @jayzhou2309, @obviyus, @jmar5439, and @mgr-nick.
- Fixed Claude CLI sessions showing runtime prompts as user messages, routed CLI prompts appearing on the owner's side of history, lost replies after long streamed turns, and post-turn compaction failing without an Anthropic API key. (#166080, #163521, #153545, #162066) Thanks @Marvinthebored, @Peetiegonzalez, @RomneyDa, @rogeriochaves, @zhangguiping-xydt, @obviyus, @methylester, @llmsommelier, and @ajmtrz.
- Fixed subagent and ACP answers being truncated, superseded child answers delivered by late receipts, and requester turns stopping when completion delivery expires. (#165800, #162843, #166139, #164282) Thanks @yetval, @holgergruenhagen, @zyz619963502zyz, @Yun-0000, @michaeljgood71, @Oldrich333, and @obviyus.
- Fixed runs aborted as stalled after completed async tools or while waiting on plugin approval, context-engine advancement lost after steering, and the tool loop refilling from the wrong context window. (#166997, #161821, #168394, #166120) Thanks @SunnyShu0925, @hannesrudolph, @fransqaas, @obviyus, @robertoronderosjr, @ruel225, and @igs-rogenlo.
- Fixed OpenAI turns failing on regex-lookaround tool schemas, ChatGPT websocket expiry and 16 MiB SSE limits, strict chat templates after runtime notices, and Code Mode calls with repeated tool-call IDs. (#166999, #167063, #166853, #167309, #165210) Thanks @scs0209, @cursoragent, @obviyus, @adamjgmiller, @Jackten, @jlapenna, and @RomneyDa.
- Fixed Codex sessions stopping after thread unloads, leaked app-server clients after model discovery timeouts, provider failures shown as a silent stop, and max thinking dropping on cron and hook turns. (#166693, #168365, #165488, #165444) Thanks @jalehman, @Oldrich333, and @obviyus.
- Fixed sessions failing every turn after a truncated image, the agent disowning earlier image answers, and memory_search snake_case arguments being rejected through tool_call. (#166564, #166165, #158632) Thanks @jayzhou2309, @mirasrael, @nogikeyaksh, @masatohoshino, and @obviyus.
- Fixed scheduled cron runs losing the Gateway plugin registry, manual cron runs losing tool access, runs rejected after catalog publication, and preflight compaction skipped for completion turns. (#166991, #168037, #168410, #163117) Thanks @67-luck, @lucianosmori, @obviyus, @RomneyDa, @SunnyShu0925, and @AXEG0.
- Fixed the Control UI hold-to-dictate button stopping on release, typed /stop letting queued turns restart the agent, repeated browser replies after background work, and pending Home creation notices piling up. (#166843, #167860, #166362, #168239) Thanks @alfredjbclaw, @obviyus, @masatohoshino, and @shakkernerd.
- Fixed update failures from absolute avatar paths, refused finalize steps leaving the Gateway stopped, and the SQLite worker launch error hidden behind a TypeError. (#164638, #166548, #165373) Thanks @nitinjwadhawan and @Shirleyyyhk.
- Fixed worker capacity leaks after forced descendant cleanup and browser tab eviction at the managed tab cap. (#168746, #166666) Thanks @aniruddhaadak80, @ruel225, and @obviyus.
- Fixed Feishu replaying obsolete streaming previews, Bedrock custom provider routes using the wrong region, the egress proxy CA rejected by strict TLS clients, and quoted Windows shell arguments in the node host. (#166610, #164406, #165818, #158160) Thanks @rudycelekli, @Takhoffman, @Ayushdevo, @obviyus, @kai-ocean-kurt, @vortexopenclaw, @RyanSandoval, @Dimitri-lcht, and @igs-rogenlo.

- dc561f0: fix(ai): prevent global type conflicts across SDK versions
- c060bd2: fix(ai): wait for chat stream cleanup when stopping
- dbf4338: fix(ai): update streaming chat messages by stable ID
- 99c9177: fix(ai): discard unrelated message state when reading resumed streams

key_changes: 多个 SDK 版本（ai@5.x/6.x/7.x）同时发版，同步了相同的核心修复
新增可选共享引用（citation）表示，用于生成文本和 text-end 流事件，与检索来源分离（provider/openai/anthropic），属实质新能力
openai-compatible 新增通过 file_id 上传文件引用支持（新能力）
大量 provider 向后兼容性改进：未知模型 ID 的 structured output、reasoning、browser search、DeepSeek reasoning、Cartesia 转录协议等

issue_insights.summary_brief: 本次扫描识别出 5 大跨仓库共性问题簇，覆盖 33 个仓库、275+ 条相关 Issue 信号，其中「文件 glob 绝对路径/非相对 pattern 不支持」「macOS scipy 原生扩展加载失败」「PostgreSQL 部署下 SQL 工具静默失败」「长会话无暂停/恢复机制」「终端图片粘贴缺失」是最具代表性的共性问题，均达到 P0 级别且影响多个主流 AI 工具链。整体看，绝大多数问题集中在 workflow_runtime 与 session_state 两类，呈现「多仓库共享底层基础设施缺陷（如 SDK 序列化、路径解析、原生依赖打包）导致同型故障扩散」的特征。
global_highlights: 跨仓 P0：文件系统 glob/路径解析对绝对路径与非相对 pattern 支持缺失（NotImplementedError）扩散至 33 个仓库，是覆盖面最广的共性问题。
跨仓 P0：macOS 上 scipy _spropack 原生扩展 dlopen 失败导致 repo 地图等启动即崩溃，暴露 AI 工具链对原生依赖打包的脆弱性（涉及 aider、OpenHands、codex 等）。
跨仓 P0：PostgreSQL 下 executeSql/MCP SQL 查询在非 superuser 角色下静默失败或返回错误结果，Arize-phoenix 为典型，Aiven 等受限托管环境普遍受影响。
跨仓 P0：长会话在 5 小时窗口到期或 context 溢出时无暂停/继续/Auto-compaction 机制，导致长任务状态与上下文无预警丢失，覆盖 14 个仓库。

top_pain_points.topic: /read-only 及类似文件 glob 命令不支持绝对路径/非相对 pattern，输入绝对路径直接触发 NotImplementedError
top_pain_points.summary: 用户在 /read-only(只读)命令中传入绝对路径或非相对 glob 模式时，命令执行抛 NotImplementedError('Non-relative patterns are unsupported')，指令无法处理而异常中断。
aliases: Windows 终端中文/块字符乱码崩溃
api key wiped on model change
async generator 未关闭导致 CLI 不退出
encoder 缓存 WaitGroup 竞争 panic
query 提前退出子进程泄漏
synctest bubble 下并发 marshal 崩溃
代理卡 loading 无超时
外部 AI 代理启动失败
嵌套路由 ls 丢目录
非 bash shell 环境初始化失败
top_pain_points.review_reason: 用户在 /read-only 等命令中使用绝对路径是常见场景，命令直接崩溃而非给出友好提示，属于命令级功能不可用，但仅 2 条且非高频核心路径，故判 P2。

source_issues.title: Uncaught NotImplementedError in pathlib.py line 1090
source_issues.evidence: cmd_read_only 中 Path(...).glob(expanded_pattern) 抛 NotImplementedError 'Non-relative patterns are unsupported'。

source_issues.title: Uncaught NotImplementedError in pathlib.py line 949
source_issues.evidence: 同主题 glob 非相对 pattern 不支持引发崩溃(索引行 1565-1610)。

source_issues.title: Uncaught UnicodeEncodeError in cp1252.py line 883
source_issues.evidence: rich console legacy_windows_render 在 cp1252 上写 '█' 块字符编解码失败。

source_issues.title: [BUG]: Playground allows invalid temperature + top_p combination for all Claude 4.x models
source_issues.evidence: 所有 Claude 4.x 模型在 UI 上可同时配置 temperature 与 top_p，执行时返回 invalid_request_error，导致 Playground 对全部 Claude 4.x 模型默认每次运行失败。

source_issues.title: [BUG]: Playground fails with all Gemini models — UniqueViolationError on trace ingestion
source_issues.evidence: 所有 Gemini 模型的 LLM 调用看似执行但 trace 无法入库抛 UniqueViolationError，输出区报错，重试/刷新均无效，而 OpenAI 模型在同类配置下正常。

source_issues.evidence: BedrockClient._build_converse_messages 把所有工具结果包成 json.loads，而 tool output 通常是非 JSON 纯文本，请求未发出即在序列化阶段崩溃。

source_issues.evidence: 流式片段按 enumerate 位置而非 index 归并，并行工具调用参数错乱，首个无 id 片段抛 KeyError 令整个 playground 运行崩溃。

source_issues.evidence: 摄取副本并发创建 ProjectSession/Trace 行时竞态触发唯一约束，违反约束的 span 被丢弃。

source_issues.evidence: Windows 桌面版填入正确 API key 并选 deepseek-v4-flash 后点保存立即 AttributeError 崩溃，配置无法保存。

source_issues.evidence: 更换模型而不重输 API key 会清空已存 key，导致切换 profile 后不断出现认证错误。

top_pain_points.topic: macOS 上 aider 的 repo 地图(/map)功能因 scipy _spropack 原生扩展动态库加载失败而崩溃，工具启动/生成上下文即中断
top_pain_points.summary: 大量 macOS(arm64)用户在运行 aider 时，当触发 repomap(仓库地图/pagerank)功能时，scipy 的 _spropack.cpython-XXX-darwin.so 原生扩展因 '__DATA/__thread_bss' 段零填充偏移错误无法 dlopen，抛未捕获 ImportError，导致主流程从启动即崩溃，/map 及依赖 repo 地图的上下文生成完全不可用。
aliases: launcher cannot start port in use
top_pain_points.review_reason: 13 条独立 issue 全部指向同一个用户可感知的阻断场景：macOS arm64 用户无论触发 /map 还是任何需要生成 repo 地图上下文的消息，都会因 scipy 原生扩展加载失败抛出未捕获 ImportError 导致工具直接崩溃退出，属于高频(count=13)+主流程阻断,且均有完整 stacktrace 与可复现链接支撑。

source_issues.evidence: 完整 traceback 从 base_coder.get_repo_map 经 repomap.get_ranked_tags 调用 nx.pagerank，最终 ImportError: dlopen(.../_spropack.cpython-311-darwin.so) 段错误零填充 section。

top_pain_points.topic: PostgreSQL 部署下 executeSql/MCP SQL 查询失败或静默返回错误结果
top_pain_points.summary: executeSql 工具在 PostgreSQL 自托管环境有两类独立故障：非 superuser 角色（受管 Postgres 常见，如 Aiven avnadmin）执行任意语句（甚至 SELECT 1）会因 SET LOCAL temp_file_limit 权限被拒使事务陷入 aborted；且嵌套路径的 ->> '$.a.b' 写法在 PG 静默返回 NULL/0 行，而 SQLite 返回正确值，无任何报错提示。
top_pain_points.review_reason: MCP SQL 查询场景下，PG 用户要么全部查询被权限问题阻断（受管 Postgres 是非 superuser 的常态），要么嵌套属性查询静默返回错误结果且无任何告警，查询不到数据却无从察觉，直接影响数据检索正确性与可用性，属于工具调用协议的实质性失败。

source_issues.title: [BUG]: executeSql fails on every query when the Postgres role is not a superuser (SET LOCAL temp_file_limit aborts the transaction)
source_issues.evidence: 受管 Postgres（Aiven，avnadmin 非 superuser）下 SET LOCAL temp_file_limit 权限被拒使事务含错误地 abort，导致含 EXPLAIN 的任意查询失败，而其他 MCP 工具正常。

source_issues.title: [BUG]: executeSql on PostgreSQL: attributes ->> '$.llm.model_name' silently returns NULL
source_issues.evidence: PG 下 ->> '$.llm.model_name' 静默返回 NULL/0 行，SQLite 返回 'gpt-4'，工具自身文档还引导用户使用该拼写，造成查不到数据的静默错误。

top_pain_points.topic: Claude Code 5 小时会话窗口到期无暂停/继续选项，长任务进度与上下文丢失

source_issues.title: placeholder
